LumaTable.description_en: The EventHouse data table information bound to the Luma Agent, including column definitions and data retention policy
LumaTable.description_zh: Luma Agent 绑定的 EventHouse 数据表信息，包含列定义与保留策略

Catalog.description_en: The name of the data catalog to which the table belongs
Catalog.description_zh: 表所属的数据目录名称
Catalog.title: 所属数据目录

Columns.description_en: The list of column definitions for the table. Each column contains Name (column name), Type (data type), and Comment (comment)
Columns.description_zh: 表的列定义列表。每列包含 Name（列名）、Type（数据类型）、Comment（备注）

Type.description_en: The data type of the column
Type.title: 列数据类型

Columns.title: 列定义列表

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the table. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 表的创建时间（Unix 时间戳，毫秒）
CreateTime.title: 创建时间

Name.description_en: The unique name of the event table
Name.description_zh: 事件表的唯一标识名称
Name.title: 表名称

Namespace.description_en: The name of the namespace to which the table belongs
Namespace.description_zh: 表所属的命名空间名称
Namespace.title: 所属命名空间

RetentionPolicy.description_en: The data retention policy, including the retention days for hot data and cold data
RetentionPolicy.description_zh: 数据保留策略。包含热数据和冷数据的保留天数

ColdTTL.description_en: The number of days to retain cold data in low-cost archival storage
ColdTTL.description_zh: 冷数据保留天数，低成本归档存储
ColdTTL.title: 冷数据保留天数

HotTTL.description_en: The number of days to retain hot data in high-performance query storage
HotTTL.description_zh: 热数据保留天数，高性能查询存储
HotTTL.title: 热数据保留天数

RetentionPolicy.title: 数据保留策略

UpdateTime.description_en: The last update time of the table. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
UpdateTime.description_zh: 表的最后更新时间（Unix 时间戳，毫秒）
UpdateTime.title: 更新时间

LumaTable.title: Luma 绑定数据表

description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified event table bound to a Luma Agent, including column definitions and the data retention policy. Only event tables that are already bound to the Agent can be queried
description_zh: 获取 Luma Agent 绑定的指定事件表的详细信息，包含列定义与数据保留策略。仅能查询该 Agent 已绑定的事件表
name: GetLumaTable

parameters.help_en: The name of the data catalog bound to the Agent. You can call ListLumaCatalogs to obtain the catalog name
parameters.help_zh: Agent 已绑定的数据目录名称。可通过 ListLumaCatalogs 获取
parameters.name: catalog

parameters.help_en: The name of the namespace bound to the Agent. You can call ListLumaNamespaces to obtain the namespace name
parameters.help_zh: Agent 已绑定的命名空间名称。可通过 ListLumaNamespaces 获取
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The name of the event table bound to the Agent. You can call ListLumaTables to obtain the event table name
parameters.help_zh: Agent 已绑定的事件表名称。可通过 ListLumaTables 获取
parameters.name: name

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of Success indicates that the call succeeds. If the call fails, a specific error code is returned
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功，失败时为具体错误码
Code.title_en: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功
Code.title_zh: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功

Data.description_en: The details of the event table bound to the Agent, including column definitions
Data.description_zh: Agent 绑定的事件表详情，包含列定义

Message.description_en: The message returned by the operation. The value is Operation success if the call succeeds, or a specific error description if the call fails
Message.description_zh: 接口返回的提示信息，成功时为 Operation success，失败时为具体错误描述

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. You can use this ID for troubleshooting and when you submit a ticket
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于问题排查与工单反馈

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of true indicates that the call succeeds
Success.description_zh: 本次调用是否成功，true 表示成功
